notes: Firsthand headline states 20 disenchants produced 1 bound weekly knowledge item, NOT saleable enchanting materials. This cohort belongs only to the first post and is not the independent Courtly Robes or Faethor cohorts below. Do not infer a material-gold yield or hit denominator.

quote: I just disenchanted 45 courtly robes my tailor made
notes: Firsthand 45 completed disenchants of crafted Courtly Robes; exact base item identity independently matched to wowhead.com/item=239672/courtly-robes. Poster says highest crafted rank and received weekly knowledge drops plus 19 catch-up items, but does NOT explicitly name each catch-up item, report their per-cast hit count, spell rank, actual ilvl, skill/spec or ordinary dust/shard outputs. Do not identify the 19 as material rank or assign Glimmering Powder item ID without provenance; conditional KP output is not gold EV.

quote: I haven’t gotten a KP item from 3 of my recent disenchants
notes: Firsthand three recent disenchant operations with zero knowledge-point item drops while nearly 80 catch-up KP remain. Reply disputes claimed guaranteed epic KP, but exact item IDs, item quality, armor/weapon, build, bonus, per-cast ordinary reagent outcomes, weekly quest and treasure prerequisites are NOT stated. Zero here is ONLY for any KP item, NOT a zero-output disenchant or an ordinary reagent. Keep separate from the two earlier authors' cohorts.
